name: codex-gears
description: Automatic task sizing for Codex: use a lighter GPT-5.6 profile for simple work and deeper Astra reasoning when the job needs it.

interface.shortDescription: Automatically match Codex speed, model, and reasoning depth to the task.
interface.longDescription: ZDH Gears sizes each task before work begins: low gear keeps simple edits fast and economical, medium gear handles ordinary implementation, and high or extra-high gear brings Astra reasoning to architecture, debugging, and production-risk work. The result is a consistent way to reduce unnecessary heavy runs while reserving deep reasoning for work that benefits from it.
defaultPrompt: Use ZDH Gears to choose the right speed and reasoning depth for this task.
